DYLA.description: Dynamic Load Allowance (DYLA). Each key is a dynamic-load-allowance entry id; FACTOR sets the impact/dynamic amplification factor applied to the structure groups named in ITEMS.

FACTOR.description: Dynamic load allowance (impact) factor applied to the listed structure groups. Stored as data.dFactor.

ITEMS.description: List of structure group names the dynamic load allowance applies to. Each name is resolved to its structure-group key; passing a non-empty list replaces the existing group assignment.
